title: Tower or ocean? Recorded MissionOS recovery judgment.

decisions.external_summary: Capture is not executable now: no capture controller connection, no certified corridor, no collected mechanism status, and zero demonstrated launch-derived catches. Splashdown is the only allowed action and has nominal modeled water-entry evidence, though it is not perturbation-qualified; choose splashdown.

recovery_report.scope: Past development simulator evidence; not current telemetry or flight certification.

catch.evidence_scope: Sequential numerical trials from one saved launch-derived separation; not independent launches.
catch.diagnosis: Saved plan, conditioned reference and actual trajectory differ; all warm replans timed out. The causal effect of conditioning/allocation is not proven. No repair has been admitted.

recovery_report.interpretation: Use demonstrated recovery maturity as judgment evidence alongside current observations and constraints. Zero demonstrated catches does not prove physical impossibility. A nominal splashdown is not assurance for arbitrary fuel, weather or separation states.
